target.title: fix(deepinfra): apply request policy to video generation requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where DeepInfra video generation requests did not apply the configured provider request policy.

## Why This Change Was Made

The DeepInfra video generation path now passes the sanitized provider request policy into its HTTP resolver, allowing custom headers, dispatcher policy, and private-network behavior to reach the actual generation request. The change does not modify model selection, provider parameters, or response parsing.

This is an AI-assisted contribution prepared for Alix-007.

## User Impact

Operators using DeepInfra video generation get consistent request-policy behavior with the rest of the provider stack, including expected proxy/header/network controls.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/deepinfra/video-generation-provider.test.ts`
- Result: 1 test file passed, 10 tests passed.
- `git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD --`
- Result: passed.
